conviction_note: Lacto Japan has never revised its forecast at a Q3 print since 2020, and its last four Q3 prints were all sold the next day (-1.88, -5.50, -0.83, -15.14). The H1 trend points to 9M progress of roughly 72-77% against 82-85% in FY24/FY25, but the delayed Singapore-plant costs and a Q2 deal whose costs were booked ahead of its revenue should support Q3 against a one-analyst EPS bar of 77. That nets to a small negative lean (p_up 45) on a 4% scale. The findings sum (-0.5) and the scaled number (-0.4) agree in sign. Both are small because the negative is an inference from public numbers.
bar: Full year: company plan ordinary profit 4,800m JPY / EPS 345.01 (Q2 tanshin https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/31390/140120260707589074.pdf, unchanged since 2026-01-14), matched by the kabuyoho consensus at 4,800m (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=3139) and Yahoo FY EPS avg 347.3 from 2 analysts. Quarter: Q3 EPS 77.22 from ONE analyst (Yahoo quoteSummary earningsTrend, 3139.T), so the quarterly bar is single-source and every quarter-level size here is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 1.51% of shares (one seller), up from 1.42% (+0.09pt, building slightly), as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via baseline). Margin ratio 11.02 (kabutan quote page 2026-10-14), so leveraged retail is crowded long, which is the one setup where a disappointing print still has sellers. No skew exists. 20d and 5d run-up are +1.76%. priced_lean_pct +0.117: the squeeze term +0.91 roughly offsets the margin overhang -0.52.

findings.finding: Lacto does not revise at Q3. Its revision history shows no Q3-print revision in FY23, FY24 or FY25 (FY23 was cut separately in December; FY25's only revision was 2025-07-09). Its last four Q3 prints all fell the next session (2022-10-14 -1.88%, 2023-10-13 -5.50%, 2024-10-16 -0.83%, 2025-10-15 -15.14%). This year's H1 ordinary profit was 2,475m, 51.6% of plan, with underlying quarters down 16-29% YoY ex the 650m FY25 compensation gain. 9M progress is therefore likely 72-77% against 81.8% (FY25) and 84.9% (FY24) at the same point, with the plan held. That reads as 'plan at risk' to a margin-long retail base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 prints with the plan held: -1.88 (2022), -5.50 (2023), -0.83 (2024), -15.14 (2025, at 81.8% 9M progress after a +58% run). Computed from Yahoo daily closes on the TDnet release dates listed on irbank.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-13 (data update); revision history rows 2023-01-13 to 2025-04-14; FY25 9M 4,907 = 81.8% dated 2025-10-14
findings.why_not_priced: The H1 progress (51.6%) is public and the stock has already de-rated to PER 10.1. What is not yet visible is the Q3 number and the 9M-vs-own-history comparison that kabutan auto-publishes at 15:30. If the market had priced a sub-par 9M, the margin long would have shrunk from 11x and shorts would not still be adding. The counter-case is rule 1: anyone can project the progress from the last tanshin, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: Company progress figures from the Q2 tanshin (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/31390/140120260707589074.pdf) and kabutan's quarterly table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3139). The reaction series comes from Yahoo bars. All rest on public company numbers, so they count once.

findings.finding: The Q2 tanshin says H1 beat the company's own H1 plan (2,250m) because the Singapore plant and the core-system go-live slipped, deferring their depreciation and interest. FISCO on 2026-08-21 still had the plant in test production with export licences pending, so those costs likely stayed light in Q3. The same tanshin says costs on one dairy transaction were booked ahead of its revenue, which should flatter a later quarter. Both support Q3 against the single-analyst EPS bar of 77.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 beat of plan by 10% on the same cost-timing reason moved the stock +0.72% (2026-07-15), so timing-driven beats have bought little.
findings.why_not_priced: The timing effect is disclosed, but nobody publishes the Q3 cost run-rate. The one analyst's Q3/Q4 split (EPS 77 then 120) puts the profit in Q4, so a Q3 that carries part of the deferred-revenue deal would read as a beat on the quarter. Had the market priced it, the analyst's Q3 number would sit above last year's 76.4 rather than level with it.
findings.independence: FISCO research memo on plant status (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3139&b=n202608210490, 2026-08-21) is a different source, but it reports company guidance, so the independence is partial.

findings.finding: USD/JPY ended Q3 close to where it ended Q2 (about 160.3 at end-May against about 160.1 on 2026-08-28), so a large FX swing in non-operating income is unlikely. H1 had carried a 109m FX gain.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction attributable to FX lines.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. It is filed only to record that FX is not the swing factor this quarter.

outside_window.finding: Whether the FY plan of 4,800m is cut. The company's pattern is a separate revision in December (2023-12-14) or none, not one at Q3, so any cut most likely lands after this window.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely at this print (none at Q3 in FY23-25; the plan was held at H1). Returns: progressive dividend with a 35%+ payout target (FISCO 2026-08-21); 132 yen planned at about 38% payout, no change expected at Q3, and only the routine 株主優待品 notice is likely. New-year guide: no, the full-year print is in January. Quarter: 9M progress likely 72-77% against 81.8% (FY25) and 84.9% (FY24); the one analyst back-loads into Q4 (EPS 77 then 120).

baseline_tension: The small negative lean agrees with the margin overhang and the slight short build, and cuts against the squeeze component. The strongest positive the release could carry is a Q3 above the one-analyst bar on deferred plant costs and the deal booked costs-first, with the plan and the progressive dividend held. I looked for it, filed it as F2 at +0.5, and it is why p_up sits at 45 and not lower.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): the strongest positive (Q3 above the bar on deferred costs, plan and dividend held) was already searched and filed as F2, so p_up was not moved again for this rule.
